Apple's all-new flagship iPhone 18 Pro and its sibling models are expected to be unveiled this autumn, continuing the company's long-standing tradition. Below are predictions for the iPhone 18 Pro launch event and release date, along with details of the product lineup.

The iPhone 18 Pro launch event is expected to take place in September, but there is one variable to consider.

The iPhone is Apple's most important product, accounting for the lion's share of the company's revenue. One of the ways Apple keeps the iPhone business healthy is by releasing new flagship models every year.

For years, these new iPhone models have gone on sale in September, and all signs indicate that this year will be no exception.

Here are the dates of the past three iPhone launch events:

  • 2025: September 9 (Tuesday)
  • 2024: September 9 (Monday)
  • 2023: September 12 (Tuesday)

As can be seen, Apple's iPhone launch schedule is remarkably consistent, typically holding its new flagship unveiling around the second week of September.

One variable in predicting this year's date is that Labor Day falls unusually late, on September 7.

Apple usually holds its iPhone launch event the week after Labor Day, so it could fall on September 14 (Monday).

However, a September 9 (Wednesday) launch event is entirely possible. Back in 2022, Apple unveiled its new iPhones just two days after Labor Day, and the company could follow suit this year.

Regardless, early-to-mid September is when the iPhone 18 Pro will officially make its debut.

However, one major change expected this year is that the base iPhone 18 will not go on sale this year, but will be pushed back to early 2027. According to reports, Apple's autumn flagship lineup this year will include:

A new iPhone Air may also be added to round out the lineup, but reports on this remain unclear at present.

iPhone 18 Pro Release Date Predictions

Although the exact date of Apple's iPhone launch event will vary slightly depending on Labor Day, once the event is over, Apple typically puts the phones on sale on a very fixed date: the Friday of the week following the event.

So if the iPhone 18 series is unveiled on September 14 (Monday), pre-orders can be expected to begin on September 18 (Friday), with the new devices reaching users on September 25 (Friday).

However, if the launch event is held on September 9 (Wednesday), pre-orders will start on September 11, with the new devices arriving on September 18 (Friday).

Looking back at Apple's recent iPhone release history confirms this pattern.

2025: iPhone 17

  • Unveiling date: September 9 (Tuesday)
  • Pre-order date: September 12 (Friday)
  • Release date: September 19 (Friday)

2024: iPhone 16

  • Unveiling date: September 9 (Monday)
  • Pre-order date: September 13 (Friday)
  • Release date: September 20 (Friday)

2023: iPhone 15

  • Unveiling date: September 12 (Tuesday)
  • Pre-order date: September 15 (Friday)
  • Release date: September 22 (Friday)

Unless Apple pulls off a major surprise this year, users can expect to get their hands on the iPhone 18 Pro on either September 18 or September 25.

iPhone 18 Pro Release Date: Summary

In summary, based on Apple's historical patterns, here are our predictions for the iPhone 18 series unveiling and release dates.

2026: iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, iPhone Ultra

  • Unveiling date: September 9 (Wednesday) or September 14 (Monday)
  • Pre-order date: September 11 or 18 (Friday)
  • Release date: September 18 or 25 (Friday)

Note: The iPhone Ultra's release date may be later than the iPhone 18 Pro, but there is currently no consensus on its exact launch timing.

Which new iPhone 18 model are you planning to buy? Let us know in the comments.
